A conversation with Sergey Brin, @joshwoodward, @tulseedoshi, and @melvinjohnsonp about Gemini 4 Argon, how we got here, and the path ahead! https://t.co/L04XLkhw8X
4 Argon is now available : )

So many great examples of Argon in action already from inside Google, our customers, and partners:
https://t.co/xM4z9uGWMd

Today we are rolling out Gemini 4 Argon globally in the Gemini API, to Pro + Ultra in Gemini App, and Ultra subs in Antigravity!

Argon is a huge step forward for Gemini, and a labor of love. This model has been battle tested by over 100,000 people at Google over the last month,
Gemini
this is the golden age of startups, builders, and developers
nearly anything is possible in the digital world with AI, and soon this will be true of the physical world (also largely due to AI)

Nano Banana 2.1 is here! 🍌

It’s a nice update for image generation and editing customers, comes with higher quality images, lots of bug fixes from previous models, and a new lower price point!

Available in the API, AI Studio, and Gemini app! https://t.co/XFG2jwLCc5

So much work by so many folks across Google to create this model, it is amazing to see the progress here, and just the start! Can't wait for more folks to use Gemini 4 Argon.

https://t.co/sc9RabG7VT

Introducing Gemini 4 Argon, our new frontier model, rolling out to cyber defenders starting today, and more widely as soon as possible. I am really excited by the progress we have made here. Argon is priced at $2 in and $10 out during introductory pricing! https://t.co/X9LNch6ObZ

2027 is the year we will see at scale autonomous revenue (profit?) generating agents / mini-companies

already happening at sub scale today with lots of rough edges

incredibly excited about all our audio model progress, from TTS, to Live, to Lyria, to Translate, to Transcribe, our suite of audio models keeps getting better for everyone. 

if you are in SF, join us tomorrow for a first of it's kind audio experince: https://t.co/eh5n7ftDTu

all of this, along with a new experince in @GoogleAIStudio, with a lower cost than our previous 3.1 Flash TTS model!  

Read more: https://t.co/GdYBOw66WW

Introducing Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS, our new SOTA text to speech model with:

- a new voice design experience
- 2,000+ production ready voices
- voice replication 
- support for 100 languages
- voice remixing (soon)
- #1 spot on Hume AI's voice benchmarks

and more!!

if you are building a product using AI, you should be spending >25% of your time making benchmarks and trying to get the model labs to care about said benchmarks

easiest path to accelerate your progress as a company
you are going to fail, so fail while daring greatly

If you are excited about Gemini Audio, come join us next week for our first of it's kind Gemini Audio experience in SF, I will be there: https://t.co/eh5n7ftDTu

And learn more about our new Live audio models: https://t.co/z8rcW5N71g

Say hello (literally) to Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, our new SOTA live audio models, available with frontier price + performance.

3.8 Live supports 97 languages (can seamlessly switch), async tool calls, and more! https://t.co/z29J9kelr3

AI progress is a journey, it’s a long road, there are setbacks, unexpected challenges, ups and downs, friends made along the way.

Important to reflect, take in the moment, learn, and keep pushing. Onwards!!
the Gemini journey

Introducing Agentic Video in the Gemini API, a new way to process long videos which reduces token consumption by up to 88% while also increasing quality. 

This can be controlled easily in the API on a per video basis, available with our newest models like 3.7 Flash! https://t.co/JrIqn4bZic
